eventTypes.title: Graduation Parties

eventTypes.title: Birthday Celebrations

eventTypes.title: Backyard Gatherings

benefits.title: Protect Your Indoor Bathrooms
benefits.description: Keeping restroom traffic outside helps preserve your home interior and reduces post-event cleanup burden. This is especially valuable for high-volume celebrations.

benefits.title: Guest Count and Duration Planning
benefits.description: A realistic guest estimate is the key input for selecting 2, 3, or 4-station units. We account for event length and likely peak usage windows to avoid undersizing.

benefits.title: Driveway and Yard Placement
benefits.description: Most private sites require advance checks for access width, turning space, and stable placement surfaces. We review those details before delivery day.

privateEventFaqs.question: Can I rent a trailer for a graduation party at home?
privateEventFaqs.answer: Yes. Graduation open houses are a top use case, and we can recommend sizing based on your expected turnout.

privateEventFaqs.question: Will this work in a driveway or backyard?
privateEventFaqs.answer: Usually yes. We confirm access and surface conditions ahead of delivery to ensure setup goes smoothly.

privateEventFaqs.question: How far out should I reserve?
privateEventFaqs.answer: Peak weekends book sooner, so early booking is recommended. We can still check short-notice availability depending on inventory.

privateEventFaqs.question: How do I know what size trailer I need?
privateEventFaqs.answer: Share your expected guest count and event duration and we will recommend the right station count. We account for all-day events with rotating guests differently than fixed-time gatherings.

privateEventFaqs.question: Do you serve areas outside Lansing?
privateEventFaqs.answer: Yes. We deliver across Mid-Michigan and nearby cities including Jackson, Howell, Flint, Ann Arbor, and Grand Rapids.
